scenicChapters.title: Beguinage de Sint-Truiden → Voormalig Stadhuis / Lakenhal
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 64 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

scenicChapters.title: Romantic Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 35 km this is Romantic Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-watchtowers-wp-13-6-to-13-12-watc.story: From Weiltingen it runs 298 km to Weiltingen; allow about 5 h 08 of riding. On the way it passes Fort site and civil settlement of Reinau-B, Fort site and civil settlement of Schirenh, Fort site and civil settlement of Murrhard and Watchtowers WP 9/14 to 9/32 including the. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
